items.excerpt: Following Wednesday's post-midterm state permitting friction and Thursday's $2.5 trillion AI equity rout (SMH -11.21%, MU -17.50%, S&P 500 -4.36%, VIX 28.18 +69.66%), Dutch lender ING put roughly $500m of data-center construction and project loans (~12 facilities, including a $25m slice tied to a New Mexico Stargate data center plus Vantage Data Centers and CyrusOne loans) up for a one-time competitive auction with bids due November 19, 2026.
